articles.headline: Hiedeman scores 24, Johnson adds 17 and Fam 10 in her debut as Storm beat Mystics 97-85
articles.description: — Natisha Hiedeman tied her career high with 24 points, rookie Flau’jae Johnson scored a season-best 17, and the Seattle Storm beat the Washington Mystics 97-85 on Sunday in a game that featured 75 total free throws, including 52 in the second half.

articles.headline: Sabrina Ionescu makes season debut as Liberty fall to Wings
articles.description: Veteran guard Sabrina Ionescu made her season debut for New York, but Dallas spoiled the party, as Paige Bueckers and Azzi Fudd each scored 24 points en route to a 91-76 victory Sunday.

articles.headline: Azzi Fudd’s third-quarter surge powers the Wings past the Liberty in Sabrina Ionescu’s debut
articles.description: — Paige Bueckers scored 24 points and Azzi Fudd added 17 of her season-high 24 in the third quarter to lift the Dallas Wings to a 91-76 win over the New York Liberty on Sunday, spoiling the season-debut of Sabrina Ionescu.

articles.headline: Reese and Canada double-doubles fuel the Dream's 82-80 win over the Mercury
articles.description: — Rhyne Howard scored 21 points, Allisha Gray added 17 and Angel Reese recorded her third double-double of the season as the Atlanta Dream used a late surge to beat the Phoenix Mercury 82-80 on Sunday.

articles.headline: Kelsey Plum scores 38 on ex-team as Sparks keep Aces winless at home
articles.description: Los Angeles Sparks guard Kelsey Plum is off to one of the hottest starts in the WNBA this season, and she burned her former team Saturday.

articles.description: — Kelsey Plum scored a season-high 38 points, Erica Wheeler hit the go-ahead 3-pointer late in the fourth quarter, and the Los Angeles Sparks defeated the Las Vegas Aces 101-95 on Saturday night.
